MASTER CALENDAR JURY
Off Calendar Feb-28-2005 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly for trial by jury.

Appearances:
John Gary Warner, Esq. on behalf of Malouk Faraji, Mina Foraji and Fooad Laghaer
Ivan Gold, Esq. on behalf of Anchorage Enterprises, LLC.

This matter settled after being sent to Judge Pro Tem. This is a global settlement of case #427951 consol. w/#608868. Terms of the settlement were as follows: Case number 427951 was dismissed. As to case number #608868 - Malouk Faraji, Mina Foraji and Fooad Laghaer stipulated to judgment in the sum of $85,000.00. An abstract of judgment will be attached as a lien on the Tiburon home. The parties agreed to stay enforcement of the judgment for 90 days commencing today 2/28/05 date. Parties agreed to CC 1542 waiver. Each side to bear own costs. The Court to retain jurisdiction pursuant to CCP 664.6. All parties agreed to the terms of the settlement on the record. Defense counsel to prepare judgment. Hon. David L. Ballati; Clerks: V. Mu/D. Okazaki Reporter: Susan Lee, #4280 (206)
